correctness.rationale: N(i)={i-2,i-1,i+1,i+2} gives n tetrahedral generators; C_n^2 has full automorphism group D_n since adjacent gap-one edges have two common neighbors and gap-two edges have one for n>=9. T_n comprises triangles {i,i+1,i+3} and {i,i+2,i+3}; all distinct, connected six-cycle vertex links, orienting chain Σ(A_i−B_i), Euler zero -> torus. The barycentric min(a,d) map on each tetrahedron sends its unique long diagonal toward the two kept faces, is identity on overlap faces, and is D_n-compatible, yielding global equivariant SDR. Rotation quotient has one vertex, three loop edges and two faces with commutator relation, so torus; reflection reverses three loop edges, swaps open triangles, fixes exactly one vertex and three edge midpoints, preserves orientation; 4 branch points give Euler 2 => S². H1 action follows degree-one loop reversal and cover transfer, H2 orientation. Independently enumerated for n=9,10,11,12,15 f(K)=(n,4n,4n,n), f(T)=(n,3n,2n), tetra overlaps in T, six-cycle links and two faces per T edge. Universal claims use symbolic argument.
